instruction: I need a presentation using three images from the Desktop: pic4.png, pic5.png, and pic6.png. Create three blank slides without any text boxes or placeholders, then insert pic4.png on the first slide, pic5.png on the second slide, and pic6.png on the third slide in that order. This presentation will be used for continuous automated display.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 3 blank slides and inserting pic4.png, pic5.png, and pic6.png sequentially. Expected: 3 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. Uses the last three images from the original set.
